metadata.title: AI Agent Platform
metadata.description: Capture website leads, qualify them automatically, and notify your team.

brand.name: Agent Platform
brand.tagline: Lead capture, qualification, and notifications for service businesses.

appShell.title: AI Agent Platform
appShell.subtitle: Lead capture, qualification, and team dashboard

landing.heroTitle: Turn website conversations into qualified leads.
landing.heroLead: Deploy an AI lead capture agent on your website, qualify inbound requests automatically, and notify your team when a lead is worth following up.
landing.dayOneTitle: What you get on day one

features.widgetDescription: Embed a chat widget on your site. Visitors talk naturally while the agent captures lead details.
features.qualificationDescription: Leads are scored and marked contactable or qualified before your team is notified.
features.emailDescription: Get Resend-powered notifications with lead summary, score, and a dashboard link.
features.dashboardDescription: Review leads, update status, and manage company settings from one place.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready for your first pilot customer?
landing.ctaDescription: Create a company, add your admin user, copy the widget snippet, and send a test message in under ten minutes.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Access your lead dashboard and pilot workspace.
login.signInFailed: Sign in failed. Check your email and password.

onboarding.title: Set up your pilot workspace
onboarding.createUserFailed: Could not create your user account.

company.title: Create company
company.description: Set up your business profile and tenant slug.

user.title: Create first user
user.description: Add the owner or admin who will manage leads.

notification_email.title: Configure notification email
notification_email.description: Choose where qualified and contactable lead alerts are sent.

copy_widget.title: Copy widget code
copy_widget.description: Copy the embed snippet for your website.

install_widget.title: Install widget
install_widget.description: Paste the snippet before </body> on your site.

test_widget.title: Test widget
test_widget.description: Send a test message and confirm a lead appears in the dashboard.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: Complete these steps to launch your pilot customer.
gettingStarted.signInRequired: Sign in to view your getting started checklist.
gettingStarted.allDone: Your pilot workspace is ready. New leads will appear on the Leads page.
gettingStarted.nextStepsDescription: After the widget is live, monitor incoming leads, tune notification thresholds in Settings, and share the dashboard with your team.

settings.pageDescription: Manage company profile, lead notifications, and website widget embed.
settings.name: Name
settings.notifyContactable: Notify on contactable leads above threshold
settings.widgetDescription: Add this snippet to your website. The widget uses slug {slug} to route messages to your company.
settings.copyFailed: Unable to copy. Select the snippet manually.

leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Review, qualify, and update inbound customer leads.
leads.emptyDescription: Install the website widget or send a test message from Demo Chat. Qualified and contactable leads will appear here.

demoChat.title: Demo Chat
demoChat.description: Test the lead capture agent before or after installing the website widget.
demoChat.emptyState: Start a conversation as a customer inquiry. The Lead Agent will ask for details like name, phone, location, and service needed.
demoChat.placeholderComplete: Lead complete. Start a new conversation to continue.
